source_equivalence_review.method: Read original tar and canonical ordered patches in memory; compare original host dispatch, JIT factory, template helper and Device implementation against the private helper. Read all four frozen entry files and supporting original-image/string-object/source receipts. No native compilation or execution by reviewer.
source_equivalence_review.template_instantiation: Byte-equivalent original get_template_definition output, including host_name, decltype, argument order, spaces and newlines. Host name is base; original Device supplies the specialized hash.
source_equivalence_review.factory: Original hidden get_steel_attention_kernel cannot be linked from this shared DSO. Its exact original utils/steel source strings plus exact instantiation are passed through the same exported Device::get_library and Device::get_kernel APIs. No ordinary-SDPA fallback, NAX kernel, new tile or whole-JIT object was substituted.
source_equivalence_review.msl_guards: Helper verifies both embedded source-string SHA values and full instantiated MSL SHA before Device/pipeline construction. Supervisor verifies original generated source and two prebuilt string-object inputs before and after every stage.
source_equivalence_review.compile_options: Inline Device overload supplies CompileOptions{} from the guarded common/metal_kernel.h: MathMode::Safe=0. Original DSO selects MSL version and preserves its NDEBUG build behavior. No custom newLibrary/math-mode path.
source_equivalence_review.module_guard: dladdr of metal::device must name the exact original same-facet libmlx.dylib, whose SHA is checked by supervisor.
source_equivalence_review.metallib_equivalence: Canonical Context::create calls read_environment -> device_info(gpu), then new_stream, without setting metallib path or math/TF32 options. Original MLX current_binary_dir uses dladdr of its own function; both shared-facet callers therefore use the original libmlx directory. The exact first colocated mlx.metallib and compiled fallback file are SHA-guarded. The old fixture-bin copy is not misreported as the actual first-loaded resource. Helper requires the original empty override and does not call its setter.

entry_review.build: Standalone CMake target, exactly one new helper TU and one link with two unchanged external string objects and imported original DSO. No product add_subdirectory, find_package(Hyle), fetch or vendor/shader build rules. Actual configure/dryplan still require execution and independent inspection.
entry_review.processes: Exactly three one-shot fresh processes: none, API-only, API+GPU. Ambient MTL keys are recorded and cleared; ambient MLX/DYLD overrides are refused. Only the two declared MTL variables differ.
entry_review.activation: Requested environment, raw API/GPU activation markers and pipeline.shaderValidation numeric are recorded separately. Missing activation cannot qualify a product or establish the intended layer comparison.
entry_review.observations: Read pipeline static threadgroup bytes/max threads/execution width/shaderValidation, device limit/name/architecture, exact source/kernel identity. Over-limit bytes are reported rather than discarded by a helper memory-limit assertion.
entry_review.no_workload: Source contains no array/eval, command encoder, explicit MTL buffer creation, dispatch or queue submission. This is not a claim that Apple compiler/validation or Device cold initialization has no internal resources.
entry_review.budgets: nice10, serial, helper build -j1, one-shot stages, frozen contract/binary hashes, 600-second entry wall budget and inherited 2026-10-17T12:08:00Z deadline. Remaining private/global budget is checked before each bounded command. Failures and partial logs persist; only own child process group is terminated on timeout.
